# 1st Class Plumbing & Gas LLC

> Licensed, bonded and insured master plumbing and gas company based in West Columbia, South Carolina, serving Lexington and Richland counties (West Columbia, Lexington, Columbia, Cayce, Irmo, Red Bank, Gaston, Springdale, Pine Ridge). Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Phone: (803) 394-8895.

## Services
- Water heater repair, replacement and upgrades (standard tank and tankless)
- Gas line installation, repair, pressure and air testing, appliance hookups
- Leak detection and repair (slab, crawlspace, wall, yard)
- Whole-house water and drain line repipes
- Plumbing fixture repair and installation (faucets, toilets, tubs, showers, disposals)
- Well system repair and installation
- Water filtration installation and maintenance
- 24/7 emergency plumbing and gas service
